apps.localizedDescription: Daily post-op Achilles program: BFR, Chris's barefoot and boot-on routines, hourly quick ones, hinge ladder, imagery. Audio cues keep going with the screen locked; reminders come from the app.

versions.localizedDescription: Calf map: swap between the side view and a view from behind with the buttons next to the model. Your choice sticks.
Calf map names in plain words: inner calf (medial gastroc), outer calf (lateral gastroc), deep calf (soleus), inner ankle, outer shin.

Calf map: Skip now goes right → left → rate, one step at a time (it used to jump past the left leg). Tibialis posterior target moved to the cord between the inner ankle bone and the arch bump, where it's easier to feel.
